name.title: Site key
name.description: Site key, made of letters, digits, underscores and hyphens. It is part of the script URL and identifies the site in charts and history, so renaming starts a separate history.

display_name.title: Display name
display_name.description: Human-readable site name for charts and Functions. Leave empty to use the site key.

allowed_origins.title: Allowed origins
allowed_origins.description: Origins the website is served from, such as `https://shop.example.org`; reports from other origins are refused. A leading `*.` matches any subdomain.

public_url.title: Public URL
public_url.description: Public base URL of the receiver for this site's script tag, such as `https://rum.example.org`. Leave empty to use the receiver's public URL.

window.title: Measurement window
window.description: Time span of recent reports that the charts, alerts and Pages view summarize, from 1m to 30m.

page_groups.title: Page groups
page_groups.description: How many of the busiest pages and application views get their own breakdown charts, from 1 to 100. The rest are combined as `other`.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: How many of the busiest countries get their own breakdown charts, from 1 to 100. The rest are combined as `other`.

measure_sample_rate.title: Browser collection rate
measure_sample_rate.description: Share of browser sessions that send reports, from 0 to 1. 1 measures every session; 0 stops collection for the site.

investigate.title: Detail sampling
investigate.description: Which measured sessions are saved to history with their details, and exported when event logs or tracing are on. Leave empty to save every session.

sample_rate.title: Baseline detail sample rate
sample_rate.description: Share of measured sessions saved with their details, from 0 to 1. 0 saves only the sessions that `always_keep` selects.

always_keep.title: Problem overrides
always_keep.description: Sessions to save whatever the sample rate - `errors` (a JavaScript error) and `poor_vitals` (a poor Web Vital). An empty list adds none.

bots.title: Bot handling
bots.description: Whether to drop reports from crawlers, headless browsers and other automation (`exclude`) or keep them as device `bot` (`include`).

tracing.title: Browser tracing
tracing.description: Record spans for the browser's requests and pass trace context to your APIs, exported as OpenTelemetry traces.

enabled.title: Enable browser tracing
enabled.description: Send browser spans to their destination. Independent of event logs.

propagate_to.title: Trace propagation origins
propagate_to.description: Origins of other APIs, such as `https://api.example.org`, whose requests also get the `traceparent` header. Requests to the page's own origin always get it.

not.$comment: IPv4 octets inside IPv6 must not have leading zeros; URI format validators differ on this.

redact_paths.title: Path redaction
redact_paths.description: Your own replacements for private identifiers in URL paths, applied before the built-in ones.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Regular expression, in Go syntax, matching the part of a URL path to replace. Empty patterns are ignored.

replace.title: Replacement
replace.description: Replacement text, such as `:account`. Leave empty to remove the match.

event_logs.title: Event logs
event_logs.description: Export browser events, including custom event attributes, as OpenTelemetry logs. Session history in Netdata works without it.

enabled.title: Enable event logs
enabled.description: Send event logs to their destination.

include_console_logs.title: Include console logs
include_console_logs.description: Also export the console info, warning and error messages of saved sessions. Requires event logs.

capture.title: Capture
capture.description: Optional location and interaction data to collect. By default only the visitor's country is looked up and click signals are off.

geolocation.title: Geolocation
geolocation.description: Location looked up from the visitor's IP address - `off`, `country`, or `city`, which adds approximate city markers to the live feed. Coordinates are never stored or exported.

frustration_signals.title: Frustration signals
frustration_signals.description: Detect rage clicks, dead clicks and clicks followed by an error. These are heuristics, not proof of user frustration.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: OTLP/gRPC receiver for this signal. Leave empty to use `http://127.0.0.1:4317`, where the Netdata OpenTelemetry plugin listens by default.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Receiver address with a port, `http://host:port` for plaintext or `https://host:port` for TLS, without a path or credentials.

auth_token.title: Authentication token
auth_token.description: Bearer token for the receiver. Use a secret reference such as `${env:OTLP_TOKEN}`. Leave empty for no authentication.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA certificate
tls_ca.description: CA certificate file to verify an HTTPS receiver. Leave empty to use the system's trusted CAs.

tls_cert.title: TLS client certificate
tls_cert.description: Client certificate file for an HTTPS receiver that requires one. Set together with the client key.

tls_key.title: TLS client key
tls_key.description: Client private key file. Set together with the client certificate.

not.$comment: IPv4 octets inside IPv6 must not have leading zeros; URI format validators differ on this.

event_logs.ui:help: Destination settings are kept while the export is disabled, and a secret reference in them must still resolve for the job to start.

include_console_logs.ui:help: Console errors are exported as logs. Uncaught exceptions and unhandled promise rejections are always collected as JavaScript errors, with or without this option.

tracing.ui:help: Destination settings are kept while the export is disabled, and a secret reference in them must still resolve for the job to start.

propagate_to.ui:help: To follow requests into the backend, instrument the backend services, allow the `traceparent` header in their CORS settings, and send their spans to the same tracing system. Browser spans alone do not show the backend side.

measure_sample_rate.ui:help:
The decision is made once per browser session: a session that is not sampled sends nothing and cannot be saved later. A browser session keeps its decision until it ends, even across page reloads, so a new rate reaches a visitor in their next session.

At 0 the script stops loading the SDK at the next page load, and the receiver discards reports from pages that are still open.

investigate.ui:help:
To save details only for problem sessions, set the sample rate to 0 and keep the default conditions. To save no sessions at all, also empty the conditions list.

Event logs and spans sent before a session matched a condition are not exported afterwards.

vnode.ui:help: Charts of this job appear under the Virtual Node instead of this host. Define a static Virtual Node through `dem:vnode` or a YAML file in `vnodes/` under the Netdata configuration directory, then enter its reference name here. Leave empty to use the collecting Agent.
